lines.say: Brain freeze! But your brain isn't actually freezing.
lines.caption: Brain freeze

lines.say: Ice cream chills the roof of your mouth and the blood vessels right above it.
lines.caption: Roof

lines.say: They squeeze tight, then suddenly swell back open.
lines.caption: Swell

lines.say: That rush sets off the trigeminal nerve, your face's pain wire.
lines.caption: Nerve

lines.say: Your brain gets the alarm and blames your forehead.
lines.caption: Forehead

lines.say: The fix: press your tongue to the roof of your mouth to warm it up.
lines.caption: Fix
